name: AzYun
description: AzYun provides a unified API gateway for a vast range of AI models — one standard API protocol to access OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and other models, with high-concurrency load balancing, transparent pay-as-you-go billing and team collaboration.
notes: AzYun provides a developer free tier for developers getting started. Public documentation is available on the official website at https://www.azyun.com.
